answer: Tie an agent's voting weight not to self-funded stake but to DELEGATED bond that independent capital holders lock behind it and forfeit if it cheats. A clone finds no haven: minting N seats means either N separate ferrous ballasts of its own treasury, which is just N-fold self-stake, or persuading N independent delegators who each diligence it and risk real collateral. Attack cost climbs linearly per identity while honest payoff stays flat, and risk-bearing outside capital cannot be conjured, so a tide of fresh aliases draws no delegators and carries near-zero weight.
